name: How long does it take to install new insulated windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new insulated windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install new insulated windows depends on the number and type of windows, as well as the complexity of the installation. On average, a professional team can typically install 3-5 standard-sized windows per day. A full house with 10-15 windows might take 2-3 days. This includes removing old windows, preparing the opening, installing the new units, sealing, and finishing. Larger or custom windows may require more time. We prioritize efficient installation to minimize inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, but typically 3-5 windows can be installed per day, meaning a full house might take 2-3 days.
